craft_notes: Sthāyin: sight-joy. Fixed 'remembering on' → 'remembering' (L3 filler repaired). Close: remembering. Rejected: 'realization' — killed: remembering kept.

lines: Face to face he sees the sure, by Rudra's powers drawn —
sky-standing in two watches' time, remembering.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran

reads_against.argmap: Face to face he sees the undoubted, Rudra-drawn; in two watches, sky-standing, remembering.
c1_essence: Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
